title: Toadpole
move_pattern: Position-dependent starting move: begins with Spiken if in front position, Whirl if not in front. Then cycles: Spiken → Spike Spit → Whirl → (repeat).
notes: Toadpole uses Thorns to defend itself. Spiken gains Thorns before attacking, Spike Spit removes Thorns while dealing multi-hit damage, and Whirl provides consistent single-hit damage. The initial move in the cycle depends on the monster's front/back positioning.
